description: This Java class `ContentFiles` serves as a data transfer object (DTO) used in a web-based admin interface for uploading and managing content files associated with a merchant. It encapsulates a list of multipart files, validates user input, and provides getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: ContentFiles
classes.description: A Java bean class used to encapsulate content file upload data, including file list and filename, with validation annotations.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the uploaded content.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with the uploaded content.
